description: Open a TuttiCode program in a visible tuttidaw.com/code tab in the user's browser so they can hear and edit it. Use it when the user wants to see or play the program; for files use code_render. Returns the program's link (`url`); when tutticode runs with --headless it opens no window and only returns the link, for you to give the user.

code.description: A TuttiCode program (Strudel-compatible pattern code with TuttiDAW extensions .inst/.fx/.midifx), at most 20,000 characters.

name: code_open
title: Open TuttiCode for the user
